An iridescent broth brewed in the Alchemical Distillery by balancing four distinct food groups.

Consuming it bestows §bAether Sight§r for §e30 minutes§r:
• §9Night Vision:§r Crystal-clear visibility in deep caves, murky water, and nighttime.
• §6Iron Stomach:§r Hunger and saturation are locked at maximum—sprinting, swimming, and regenerating health will never deplete your food.

Can be eaten even when your hunger bar is completely full.
